name: observability
description: [skills] Set up an app's observability by sparring with Claude one perspective at a time (purpose, incident detection, logging, product analytics, metrics and SLOs, release health, privacy and cost, operations), then put in stack-matched code (logger, error monitoring, typed analytics wrapper, correlation IDs, redaction) for iOS, Android, Expo, Flutter, web, Node, Python, Go, Rails or JVM, plus a decision record, logging rules, a tracking plan, alerts with runbooks and a dependency-free checker. Also adds events, triages incidents and checks the rules
